capability.title: Reliability, CI and Runtime Operations
capability.outcome: CI, local validation, provider credentials, scheduler runs, defects and reruns are observable, bounded and reproducible.
acceptance_criteria: Failure and rerun semantics are explicit.
validation: CI contract, full pytest, Ruff and operational smoke evidence.

stories.title: Env-Aware Controlled Provider Runs
stories.outcome: Allowlisted provider keys load from an explicit env file without shell sourcing or secret output.
acceptance_criteria: Env file is never executed as shell.
Audit records provider and request cap, not secret.
validation: Credential-handling tests and two-request smoke with operator approval.

stories.title: Scheduler and Orchestrator Capability Audit
stories.outcome: Schedules, idempotency, attention steps, stops, retries and hidden side effects are proven.
acceptance_criteria: Current schedule truth and owner known.

stories.title: Defect and Failure Taxonomy Baseline
stories.outcome: Pipeline, technical, operational and governance failures have explicit classes, owners and next actions.
acceptance_criteria: Criticality, reproducibility, owner, evidence and closure criteria defined.
validation: Sample classification across test, scheduler, provider and gate failures.

stories.title: E402 Import Policy and Baseline Closure
stories.outcome: Historical sys.path/import behavior is either refactored or narrowly governed, and E402 reaches zero or explicit finite exceptions.
validation: Full Ruff, script invocation tests and CI.

stories.title: CSV Producer Marker Hardening
stories.outcome: Review-output CSV producers are explicitly marked and strict enforcement can be considered.
acceptance_criteria: Unmarked count reaches zero or finite documented exceptions.

stories.title: Main-Branch CI Observability and Required-Check Policy
stories.outcome: Operators can verify post-merge CI and branch protection instead of relying only on PR-run evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Required check name and branch protection decision documented.
validation: Merge/push run smoke and GitHub status verification.

stories.title: Local VALIDATE and GitHub CI Contract Alignment
stories.outcome: Local unified validation and GitHub CI have a documented superset/subset relation with no hidden divergent truth.
acceptance_criteria: Each check has owner, trigger and failure semantics.
Full suite and contract checks match documented policy.
validation: Contract test and sample local/CI comparison.
